checks.name: memory: authority is saved while account gate is closed; unknown owner is rejected
memory: real adapter chains assistant/import/routing with durable resource receipts and dependency
memory: signed forwarded inbound plus bound successful Vapi report establishes observed readiness
memory: untrusted, misrouted and unbound events never certify service
memory: lost assistant create response before effect never blindly creates again
memory: lost assistant create response after effect never blindly creates again
memory: lost phone-number create response before effect never blindly creates again
memory: lost phone-number create response after effect never blindly creates again
memory: lost routing response is reconciled by readback without a second update
memory: pause during assistant create retains the receipt but blocks call handling and stale activation
memory: rules stop serving until current review/test, then automatically update the same resources
memory: fallback is provider-authenticated and separately reports observed and answered
memory: unanswered fallback speaks from the Dial action and retains the exact destination outcome
memory: completed fallback records a transport connection once without promising a human or another call
memory: a fallback callback cannot adopt another caller or an unattempted dial
memory: known own-number reentry ends without dialing or routing back into the assistant
memory: old callbacks never dial a replacement tenant or stamp its current voice generation
memory: old generation dial events cannot become current readiness evidence
memory: stale AI routing and paused AI retain only the unchanged approved owner fallback
memory: voice-only detachment preserves approved fallback while account and number stops do not
memory: AI and fallback reserve separate bounded legs and an unknown same-parent outcome never dials twice
memory: exhausted tenant and account capacity refuse fallback before a Dial without refund or refill
memory: duplicate end reports retain one immutable call receipt and no duplicate effect
memory: customer cancellation confirms route detachment and resource cleanup before dependency release
memory: parent number cancellation automatically starts child cleanup
memory: concurrent requests and workers retain one assistant create and one import
memory: cancellation during in-flight creation retains late receipt before cleanup
memory: ended calls reject delayed tools and reserve call usage only once
memory: root dispatcher saves one real lead for a repeated call tool and reports delivery honestly
memory: three ready customers refresh in one leased background wave before stale routing expires
memory: admission rejects the 26th active operation before provider resource creation
memory: actual inbound calls stop at the approved per-customer daily budget
memory: owner cancellation remains available after execution policy is removed
memory: lost child acknowledgment after actual dependency CAS cannot strand number cleanup
memory: testing to live adopts the lifecycle and answers with the same acquired resources
memory: pause and resume recover automatically without another purchase or owner approval
memory: a solo operator can use the new number with a generic non-looping fallback
memory: the acquired new number can be the advertised business line without a forwarding loop
